summary: CIBC filed a Form 6-K announcing senior executive leadership changes effective May 28, 2026. Susan Rimmer was appointed Senior EVP and Group Head, Commercial Banking, now also overseeing U.S. Commercial Banking and the Office of the CEO. Eric Belanger was appointed Senior EVP and Group Head, Wealth Management, overseeing North American wealth businesses. Christina Kramer transitions to Special Advisor and will leave the bank on October 31, 2026, following a 40-year career. These changes are internal management shifts, not an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. No deal terms or shareholder vote were involved.
